workers.name: Codex independent Beiqishu 026 canonical chronology auditor

summary: Fresh complete independent canonical audit: all 96 Chinese units, 75 temporal or active-hint items, and 24 people were checked. Most regnal dates, era ranges, precision, event ownership, and reception classifications are source-grounded. Eighteen linked claim/hint items across nine people require revision because undated meetings, bare offices and titles, retrospective military wording, and adjacent family or education narratives were converted into unsupported personal activity intervals. The chapter remains needs-revision; this audit makes no extraction change.
